name: Wall Ball
description: Front squat combined with an overhead toss to a wall target — a CrossFit benchmark movement.

commonFaults.fault: Not using the legs to drive the toss
commonFaults.cue: Let the squat rebound power the throw, not just the arms

stages.name: Wall Ball — Light Ball, Low Target

name: Pistol Squat
description: Single-leg squat to full depth with the other leg extended forward — significant balance and strength demand.

commonFaults.fault: Heel lifting off the ground
commonFaults.cue: Keep weight through the heel, work on ankle mobility if this persists

stages.name: Assisted Pistol
stages.description: Holding a rig or band for balance.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Stepping forward into alternating lunges — foundational single-leg strength and stability movement.

commonFaults.fault: Knee caving inward or past the toes excessively
commonFaults.cue: Track the knee over the toes, control the step length

scaling.description: Loaded (dumbbells or barbell back rack), 20+ steps/side

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Stepping backward into a lunge instead of forward — generally gentler on the front knee.

commonFaults.fault: Leaning too far forward
commonFaults.cue: Keep torso upright throughout the step

name: Front Rack Lunge
description: Lunge performed with load held in the front rack position — adds core and upper back demand.

commonFaults.fault: Elbows dropping under load
commonFaults.cue: Keep elbows up throughout each step

name: Overhead Lunge
description: Lunge with the load locked out overhead throughout — significant shoulder stability demand.

commonFaults.fault: Bar drifting forward of midline
commonFaults.cue: Keep the load stacked directly overhead

name: Sandbag Lunge
description: Lunge carrying a sandbag in front rack, on the shoulder, or bear-hugged.

commonFaults.fault: Losing bracing under the shifting load
commonFaults.cue: Brace core hard before each step

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Deadlift variation with a smaller range of motion, bar staying above the knee — emphasizes hamstrings.

commonFaults.fault: Squatting the movement instead of hinging
commonFaults.cue: Push hips back, keep knees only slightly bent

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hip-hinge-powered swing of a kettlebell — foundational conditioning and posterior chain movement.

commonFaults.fault: Squatting the swing instead of hinging
commonFaults.cue: Drive with the hips, keep the movement a hinge not a squat

stages.name: Russian Swing
stages.description: Swing to chest height, light KB.

stages.name: American Swing
stages.description: Full overhead swing, Rx KB weight.

name: Good Morning
description: Hip hinge with the bar racked on the back (like a squat setup) — posterior chain accessory movement.

commonFaults.fault: Rounding the back at the bottom
commonFaults.cue: Keep a neutral spine, stop the hinge before the back rounds

name: Front Rack Carry
description: Loaded carry with implements held in the front rack position instead of at the sides.

commonFaults.fault: Elbows dropping under load
commonFaults.cue: Keep elbows up, load resting on the shoulders

name: Overhead Carry
description: Loaded carry with the implement locked out overhead throughout the walk.

commonFaults.fault: Arm drifting forward of the ear
commonFaults.cue: Keep the load stacked directly overhead, bicep by the ear

name: Suitcase Carry
description: Single implement carried on one side only — strong anti-lateral-flexion core demand.

commonFaults.fault: Leaning toward the loaded side
commonFaults.cue: Keep torso upright, resist leaning

name: Bear Hug Carry
description: Loaded carry with the implement hugged against the chest.

commonFaults.fault: Losing bracing partway through the carry
commonFaults.cue: Brace hard, reset breath if needed

name: Box Jump
description: Jumping onto an elevated box — power and coordination movement.

commonFaults.fault: Landing with a hard, stiff-kneed impact
commonFaults.cue: Land soft, knees tracking over toes, absorb through the hips

stages.name: Step-Up
stages.description: No jump, stepping onto a low box.

name: Box Jump Over
description: Jumping onto the box and immediately over to the other side, rather than stepping back down.

commonFaults.fault: Landing heavily on the far side
commonFaults.cue: Absorb the landing softly, same as the jump up

name: Broad Jump
description: Standing long jump for horizontal distance — power and landing mechanics.

commonFaults.fault: Landing off-balance or falling forward
commonFaults.cue: Focus on sticking the landing before chasing max distance

scaling.description: Focus on landing mechanics, moderate distance

name: Burpee Box Jump
description: A Burpee immediately followed by a Box Jump — unlocked once both parent movements are reliable.

commonFaults.fault: Rushing the transition from burpee to jump
commonFaults.cue: Stand fully before initiating the jump

name: Burpee Box Jump Over
description: A Burpee immediately followed by jumping over the box, rather than stepping down — unlocked once both parent movements are reliable.

commonFaults.fault: Landing heavily on the far side
commonFaults.cue: Absorb the landing softly on both sides of the box

name: Bear Crawl
description: Quadrupedal movement on hands and feet, knees hovering just off the ground.

commonFaults.fault: Hips popping up too high
commonFaults.cue: Keep hips low and level with the shoulders

name: Crab Walk
description: Reverse of the Bear Crawl — facing up, hips lifted, moving on hands and feet.

commonFaults.fault: Hips sagging toward the floor
commonFaults.cue: Keep hips lifted throughout the walk

name: Inchworm
description: Walking the hands out from standing to a plank position and back — a mobility/warm-up staple as much as a standalone movement.

commonFaults.fault: Rushing through without feeling the stretch
commonFaults.cue: Pause briefly in the plank position each rep

scaling.description: 5-8 reps, focus on hamstring stretch and control
10+ reps, added push-up at the bottom
